Organic-only reach

Sales follow your posting

4,290 posts is a huge body of work. But when a week gets busy and you post less, fewer new women find the workshop, the Club or you.

Free, then a big jump

From free straight to a commitment

A new follower goes from free content to a monthly membership or 1:1. There’s no easy, paid first yes in between that turns a follower into a buyer.

No buyer-to-applicant path

1:1 clients find you by chance

Nothing walks a small buyer to “I’m ready for 1:1” on autopilot, so you can’t tell who is serious until you’re already in the conversation.

You already have the expertise, the books and the community. What’s missing is a £27 front door that ads fill every day, and a free application that turns buyers into qualified 1:1 clients.

My recommendation

An always-on £27 toolkit, fed by Meta ads every day

It sits alongside your free workshop, your classes and the Club, not in place of them. A low-ticket toolkit with an order bump, the More Great Days Club as the upsell and a small downsell, with a free 1:1 application on the welcome page so buyers become applicants.

The Joyful Coach

Sound familiar?

Busy every day. Joyful on too few of them.

  • Your to-do list gets your best energy, and you get whatever is left.
  • The things that make you happy keep moving to “next week”.
  • You know what you “should” do for yourself, but it never quite fits in.
  • You want more good days, without adding another big project to your life.

Questions

Before you grab the toolkit

I’m really busy. Will I have time?

Yes. That’s who it’s for. The video is 45 minutes, and every tool after that takes five to fifteen minutes.

Is this therapy?

No. It’s coaching and positive psychology education, not therapy, medical or mental health treatment.

How is this different from the More Great Days Club?

The toolkit is a one-off set of tools to start with. The Club is ongoing support and community, if you want to keep going.

Why is it only £27?

Because the first step should be easy. Use the toolkit, feel the difference, and decide afterwards if you want to go further with me.

Ad creatives · Video scripts

Ad scripts: talking to camera

Same warm, bright energy as your reels. 30 to 45 seconds each.

Script 1 · “The 5-minute joy menu”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here are three things a positive psychologist does when there’s no time for anything.”

Body

“One: step outside for five minutes, no phone. Two: message someone you love, just because. Three: write down one good thing from today. Tiny, doable, and they add up to more great days.”

CTA

“My full joy menu, plus a weekly planner, is in the Great Days Toolkit. It’s £27. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: Sophie to camera against a soft grey wall, each idea appears as text with a yellow highlight.

Script 2 · “Joy isn’t a reward”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Joy isn’t something you earn once the to-do list is done.”

Body

“The list is never done. The busy women I coach who have more great days don’t wait for a quiet week. They put the good stuff in first: small, planned moments that fit around everything else.”

CTA

“The Great Days Toolkit shows you how, with a 45-minute training and my weekly planner. £27, instant access. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: Sophie holding a cup of tea, on-screen text “joy first, not last” with “first” highlighted in coral.

Script 3 · “From the author of Choose Joy”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“I wrote a book about choosing joy. This is the short version.”

Body

“Notice what makes a day good. Make a little more room for it. Say a kind no to some of the rest. That’s it. The toolkit turns those three steps into worksheets you can use this week.”

CTA

“Get the Great Days Toolkit for £27. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: Sophie holding her books, then a quick cut to the planner on a phone. Add “Educational content, not medical advice” on screen.
